question: Can fixed historical OHLC aggregation halve input positions while retaining useful validation behavior and reducing measured resources?
estimand: Single-seed descriptive validation loss and resource difference between raw96 and mixed48 input representations; feasibility diagnostic only
scope: ETHUSD only; exploratory development choice after earlier asset results, not independent confirmation or asset-selection evidence
source_use_basis: Inherited bounded local non-commercial CDD Bitstamp research release; no new download or new upstream license claim

data_contract.grid: 24/7 daily completed Bitstamp candles; original window spans 96 calendar days
data_contract.unit: USD per ETH; same train-fitted channel normalization as parent
data_contract.target: Next daily candle Close; unchanged parent normalized target
data_contract.test: Not read or evaluated in this pilot; no test role is passed to workers
data_contract.keys: Parent model-independent train/validation keys copied unchanged; full validation coverage including tail batches
data_contract.normalization: Frozen parent ETH f100 scaler; shared by both arms; no refit or validation-dependent transform
data_contract.metric_denominator: Parent full-train mean squared daily Close difference, identical in both arms

mixed48.transform: First 64 daily rows form 16 ordered non-overlapping four-day OHLC blocks; append last 32 daily rows unchanged. Block O=first O, H=max H, L=min L, C=last C.

transform_constraints: Deterministic, causal within each completed 96-day context; no learned grouping, thresholds, sample deletion, interpolation, new features, or target access. Positive affine train normalization commutes with per-channel OHLC aggregation.

model.reference: Same pinned full DeReFusion source/configuration as parent, except seq_len=48 for mixed48
model.capacity_comparison: d_ff/d_model=4 and d_model/n_heads=8 unchanged; raw96=21743 parameters, mixed48=21599 (three time projections shorten by 48 each); no claim of pure preprocessing-only causal isolation
model.checkpoint: Complete validation MSE every 50 steps; strict minimum, ties retain earlier; all 600 steps run
model.initialization: Same seed but sequence-dependent layers differ in size, so complete parameter draws are not identical across arms

baselines.ridge: Each arm uses its own flattened windows; parent lambda grid [0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100], validation selection, intercept unpenalized
baselines.persistence: Last daily Close is unchanged by compression; predictions must match exactly across arms

measurements: validation original-unit MSE and RMSSE F/L/P
training-phase process peak working-set bytes on Windows
input tensor bytes and fixed-aggregation time
timing_caveat: One fresh subprocess per arm, raw96 then mixed48; no timing repeats, random order, thermal/cache control, or statistical resource claim
failure_policy: Fail closed on binding/coverage/non-finite/resource violations; retain failure and no automatic retry
interpretation: No numeric acceptance threshold invented; report observed loss/resource tradeoff. This pilot cannot establish superiority, generalization, pure mechanism, or suitable final data selection.
mixed_time_resolution_caveat: The source model treats all 48 positions equally: early positions span four days, recent positions one day; moving_avg=25 now has a different varying wall-clock span and RevIN weights summarized blocks equally. No claim of preserving daily-grid model semantics.
publication: Local internal pilot; raw data, role arrays, per-key predictions and checkpoints remain gitignored. Summary release requires separate review. Active R1 confirmation is unchanged.
